result.description: A fictional desktop MIDI and light-control hub designed for studio mood sequencing and performance automation. The Aural Bloom CM-72 combines 12 assignable RGB pads, dual USB-C host ports, and a quiet fanless aluminum chassis for use in rehearsal rooms, installation art spaces, and boutique broadcast booths. It supports scene recall, clock sync, and per-channel color mapping, with 32 onboard presets and a 48 kHz control engine. Includes Windows, macOS, and Linux companion software for routing, macro assignment, and firmware updates.
result.title: Aural Bloom CM-72 Ambient Controller
